details: Currently developing a mobile-based augmented reality navigation system to guide users within the university campus using QR code scanning, real-time camera view, and AR directional arrows with my team.

title: LibriCore - Cloud-Based Library Management System
summary: A cloud-hosted library system with containerized services, CI/CD, and AWS deployment automation.
details: LibriCore is a full-stack, cloud-hosted library management system with containerized frontend, backend, and database, automated CI/CD using Jenkins, and deployment on AWS using Docker and infrastructure automation.

title: Qaleesi - Volunteering Platform
summary: A full-stack volunteering platform with authentication, profiles, idea sharing, CRUD, and messaging.
details: Qaleesi is a volunteering platform designed especially for girls, developed for the EC4307 Web Application Development module. It includes authentication, profile management, idea sharing with images, CRUD for ideas, and user-to-user messaging.

title: LAN File Drop - Local Network File Sharing System
summary: A LAN file-transfer tool with C++ sockets, device discovery, and a lightweight web interface.
details: Developed a network programming project to enable fast file and folder transfer between devices on the same LAN. Built a C++ socket-based backend with UDP device discovery and TCP-based reliable transfer for single files, multiple files, and full folder structures. Added transfer logging with timestamps and remote IP tracking to monitor activity. Also developed a lightweight web interface for sending and receiving files, viewing live logs, and LAN screen mirroring to improve usability over a CLI-only workflow.

title: Book Recommendation System - Machine Learning Project
summary: A clustering project that finds patterns in reader engagement and book metadata.
details: Developed a machine learning project to cluster books based on reader engagement and metadata features from the Goodreads dataset. Using attributes like average rating, ratings count, text review count, number of pages, publication year, and genre to identify natural book categories such as short popular books versus long niche titles. Compared partitional and hierarchical clustering techniques to uncover patterns in reader preferences.
